usage: Transparent facial artwork projected onto the existing 3D heads. Original PNGs are kept unchanged; runtime upload downsamples them to a maximum 512px edge.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production facial-feature decal texture for an existing 3D game character. A single front-orthographic face-feature stencil on a genuinely transparent background. Draw ONLY the eyebrows, eyes including opaque white sclera and irises/pupils, nose linework, mouth and character-specific face markings. All other pixels transparent: NO skin fill, no head outline, no jaw outline, no hair, no ears, no headband, no helmet, no neck, no body, no border, no text. The transparent negative space is essential, this artwork will be projected onto an already sculpted skin-colored 3D head. Flat crisp canonical animation linework, not a realistic human, not chibi, not a generic anime avatar. Portrait canvas: both eyes centered around 34% and 66% width at 36% height, eyebrows around 23% height, nose around 55%, mouth around 77%; all artwork within 12%-88% width and 16%-88% height. Eyes and facial expression must be recognizable and true to the named character's original show, with confident expression. No lighting, no cast shadows, no glossy rendering, no checkerboard drawn into the background. Character: adult Son Goku in his normal black-haired base form from Dragon Ball Z. Precisely the recognizable Akira Toriyama Goku facial design: long sharp angular eyes with nearly triangular white shapes, small round black pupils, thick strong angled black eyebrows, angular pointed anime nose drawn with a few black strokes, subtle confident closed-mouth grin. Distinctive adult Goku, not Super Saiyan, no blue eyes, no long eyelashes, no round cute eyes. No hair at all; the hair is already modeled.
